notes.title: 20201206 Emergency Version Update notice
notes.notes:
Dear friends, a lot of problems after the game is launched, hereby apologize to you, although the game is 2 individual development, but we'll think of some way to spare no effort to maintain updated, also hope you put forward valuable advice, help the game further optimization, put forward the content of what you want, play, we strive to do it! .





  This update optimizes the following:



1. Solve the problem that the role interface cannot be entered

2. Solve the problem that DLC cannot enter the role interface

3. Solved the problem that the attack power and attack speed are too high to show

4. Solved the problem of ineffectiveness of the astrosphere

5. Solved the problem that some effects of the mirror skill card were incorrect or invalid

6. Optimize the overall strength of the BOSS, reduce the overall hit point strength of the BOSS, and reduce the skill strength of some bosses

7. Optimized the model problem after the role rose to the star, and solved the problem that some models were too large to block the screen

8. Optimized the problem that too many special effects of some high star characters caused the problem of lag


This is a new attempt of the philosophy group. Our ability is limited, but our ideas are unlimited. We hope that players can support us, give us more feedback, and support us to continue to do it.


thank you
